articles.title: Rahul Dravid’s Son Anvay Smashes 151 As Karnataka Pull Off Stunning 352-Run Chase
articles.description: Anvay Dravid, son of India batting legend Rahul Dravid, delivered a standout performance for Karnataka Under-19. He scored a blistering 151 to secure his team’s place in the Vinoo Mankad Trophy knockouts. Karnataka defeated Gujarat by 5 wickets on Friday after completing a daunting chase in a high-scoring contest. Leading the side, Anvay took just 100 deliveries to compile his century-plus innings, striking 20 boundaries and three sixes. Anvay & Dhruv Power Karnataka Into Knockouts The defining partnership came when Anvay and Dhruv joined forces to rebuild Karnataka’s innings and then accelerate towards victory. The pair added 203 runs for the third wicket in a little over 26 overs, putting Gujarat’s bowling attack under sustained pressure. Both batsmen maintained an attacking approach, ensuring that Karnataka remained on course despite the enormous target. Anvay’s leadership and his ability to convert a strong start into a massive individual score made the innings particularly significant in the knockout qualification race. His effort proved decisive as Karnataka hunted down a target revised to 352 under the VJD method, reaching the required total in 45.3 overs. The youngster found an equally destructive partner in Dhruv Krishnan, who also produced a century from 100 balls, finishing with 131. Gujarat’s Batsmen Set Up Run-Fest Gujarat had earlier piled up 357 for four in their allotted 50 overs, with Sameer Bhandari and Yash Panjwani producing outstanding unbeaten hundreds. Bhandari struck 119 not out from 88 deliveries, while Panjwani finished unbeaten on 106 off just 57 balls. Their explosive partnership transformed Gujarat’s innings after the team had slipped to 140 for four in 30.3 overs. The fifth-wicket stand yielded 217 runs in only 19 overs, giving Gujarat a commanding platform and setting up a contest dominated by attacking cricket. However, Anvay and Dhruv answered that challenge with a remarkable partnership of their own. Their performances carried Karnataka through to the next stage and placed Anvay’s achievement firmly in the spotlight as the tournament moves towards its knockout rounds.

articles.title: Top 5 Indian Batters With Most T20I Sixes: Abhishek Climbs To No. 3, No. 1 Will Shock You
articles.description: Top 5 Indian Batters With Most T20I Sixes: Abhishek Sharma’s explosive approach has quickly made him one of India’s most destructive batters in T20 Internationals. The left-hander is closing in on the 150-six mark and has already entered the top five among Indian players in the format. At the top of the list remains Rohit Sharma, whose record-setting tally continues to set the benchmark for India’s biggest hitters. Top 5 Indian Batters With Most Sixes In T20Is 1. Rohit Sharma: 205 sixes Rohit leads India’s list with 205 sixes in 151 T20I innings. The former captain remains one of the format’s most prolific power-hitters despite retiring from T20 Internationals. His tally also places him among the leading six-hitters in men’s T20I cricket worldwide. 2. Suryakumar Yadav: 179 sixes Suryakumar Yadav occupies second place with 179 sixes in 107 innings. Known for his unconventional strokeplay and ability to find gaps across the ground, he has been one of India’s key attacking batters in the shortest format. 3. Abhishek Sharma: 142 sixes Abhishek has struck 142 sixes in 65 T20I innings, putting him eight hits away from reaching 150. His aggressive approach from the opening ball has helped him climb the rankings quickly. He has scored 2,065 runs in T20 Internationals, including three centuries and 14 half-centuries. Abhishek has also hit 199 fours, leaving him one boundary short of the 200-mark in that category. His recent performances, including a 61 in the Asian Games final and a 69 in Indore, have added to the attention surrounding his rapid rise. The upcoming matches against the West Indies could give him another opportunity to close in on the milestone. 4. Hardik Pandya: 126 sixes Hardik Pandya is fourth with 126 sixes in 109 innings. The all-rounder has regularly provided India with late-innings power, combining his ability to clear the boundary with contributions across batting and bowling. 5. Virat Kohli: 124 sixes Virat Kohli completes the top five with 124 sixes in 117 T20I innings. Although he has retired from the format, his record keeps him among India’s leading six-hitters in T20 Internationals. Sanju Samson is another Indian batter to have crossed the 100-six mark in the format. Can Abhishek Sharma Reach 150 Sixes Soon? With 142 sixes already to his name, Abhishek is within reach of another significant T20I milestone. His attacking style gives him opportunities to make rapid progress, although the timing will depend on his performances in the coming matches. Rohit’s tally of 205 remains the benchmark at the top of India’s list. Abhishek’s rise, however, highlights how quickly the next generation of Indian T20 batters is making its mark.
